description: This file defines the OctoUtils class with static methods for handling blocks, duplicating block trees, and filtering conditions in a web application related to Focalboard, including hydration, merging, duplication, and filter string generation.

classes.name: OctoUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing blocks, duplicating block trees, and generating filter condition display strings in a Focalboard web application.

methods.name: hydrateBlock
methods.description: Creates a block instance based on its type, hydrating it with the appropriate creation function.

methods.name: mergeBlocks
methods.description: Merges two arrays of blocks, updating existing blocks and adding new ones.

methods.name: duplicateBlockTree
methods.description: Duplicates a tree of blocks, assigning new IDs and optionally remapping board IDs.

methods.name: filterConditionDisplayString
methods.description: Returns a localized string describing a filter condition based on its type and value.

methods.name: filterConditionValidOrDefault
methods.description: Validates or defaults a filter condition based on its value type.
